sut.name: trainticket
sut.deploy: SPECIFIED (not yet captured on the a1767ab3 deploy): requires a FORK build of ts-admin-route-service with the Gate-1 injection point MIST_FAULT_LOSTWRITE_ENABLED=true; the current kind 'mist' cluster runs the UPSTREAM base ts-admin-route-service:1.0.0 (no fault flag), so this positive is designed/label-known but not live-captured. Original Gate-1 deploy: k8s via make deploy + OTel->Jaeger.

readback.locator: GET /api/v1/adminrouteservice/adminroute [route with the submitted id present in the returned list]

stimulus.script: valid route: >=2 existing stations, startStation and endStation both in stationList, names 2-50 chars

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: With the flag on, createAndModifyRoute returns status:1 'create and modify success' but SKIPS the persist POST to ts-route-service, so the route is never saved. The acknowledgement is a clean success; the write is lost. Norm derivable from the SUT contract (a create that acks success must persist); the absent durable row is presented via read-back: GET getAllRoutes does not list the route id.

provenance.notes: Lost-write positive on a SKIPPED CROSS-SERVICE persist: no downstream call is made, so there is no 5xx and no error span (naive_span_error / mist_trace_shape pass it clean), but the expected ts-route-service persist span is ABSENT -> a Tracetest presence-assertion authored on that span catches it (tracetest_presence=flag), as does MIST's read-back. This is NOT a clean MIST-unique win: it contrasts with the fabricated-ack cases (cancel-fabricatedack, createaccount-agreement) where the downstream call IS made and returns fake success, so the span is present and only the read-back catches it. rev-2 migration (2026-07-09): v0.1.0 injection -> fault{mechanism=flag, injection_method=sut_injector, by-injection}; readback_endpoint -> typed readback; trace_visibility=span-presence-visible; ADDED tracetest_presence_oracle=flag (skipped cross-service span is absent -> presence-assertion true-positive at authoring cost). Status: SPECIFIED (Gate-1-era fork commit 5c471dd8; the fork ts-admin-route-service image is not deployed on the current a1767ab3 cluster). Contract-diversity/breadth case: shows the fault class is not cancel/inside-payment-specific. REVIEW-CORPUS R2/B-f3: SPECIFIED design-target -- the trace columns (naive_span_error=no_flag, tracetest_presence=flag, mist_trace_shape=no_flag) are the intended-instrumented expectation (require write-path span instrumentation); on an uninstrumented deploy they are not_applicable, and no specified case is tallied as a measured result until captured.
